title: Live Streaming & Farewell Media Partnership
subtitle: Prepared for Lashibi Funeral Homes
details: All Souls' Chapel · Pavilion · Garden of Peace · Nungua–Lashibi–Ashiaman Road
tagline: No family member left out of the final farewell.
to: The Management, Lashibi Funeral Homes, Opposite Ghana Highways Quarters, Nungua–Lashibi–Ashiaman Road, Accra
re: Partnership Proposal for Live Streaming and Media Coverage of Farewell Services at Lashibi
paras: Almost every family you serve has loved ones who cannot be there: children and siblings abroad, elderly relatives in the village, friends who cannot travel. Today many of them watch a shaky phone video on WhatsApp, if anything at all. With All Souls' Chapel, the Pavilion and the Garden of Peace on one site, Lashibi is ideally placed to offer every family a dignified, professional live broadcast of the farewell. Film Beyond Imagination (FBI) would like to make that a standard Lashibi service.
## What families would receive

- A private live stream of the service in the chapel or pavilion and the committal at the Garden of Peace, in clear HD with clean sound, on a private link families share with relatives anywhere in the world.
- A full recording of the service, delivered after the funeral as a lasting keepsake.
- A tribute video of the life of the deceased, from family photographs, played at the service and shared online.
- Photography of the service, the family and the guests.
- A memorial film with highlights of the day, and optional drone footage of the procession and grounds.
## What Lashibi gains
- A new premium service to add to your packages, delivered entirely by our crew, with partner rates that leave room for your margin.
- A permanent streaming setup option for All Souls' Chapel and the Pavilion: discreet fixed cameras and sound, so streaming is ready for every ceremony.
- Your name on every stream watched by relatives at home and abroad, who will remember where the farewell was held.
- Promotional films and photography of your chapel, pavilion, crematorium and grounds for your website and social media.
## Why FBI

We already cover funerals and live events across Ghana, including our recent funeral coverage at Kaswa. Our crew is respectful and discreet, arrives early to set up and test, and brings backup internet so the stream stays up.
To let you judge the quality yourself, we will stream one farewell service at Lashibi at no cost to you or the family. We would welcome a short meeting at your premises to arrange it.
